reviews.t: Viennoiserie Patisserie is a charming little spot that instantly draws you in with its beautiful pastry display. Everything looks so delicate and tempting that it is hard to choose just one item. I tried a couple of pastries and they were light, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The croissants were nicely flaky and buttery, and the desserts were not overly sweet, which I really appreciated. The shop itself feels cozy and elegant, perfect for a quick treat or a small indulgent break during the day. Service was friendly and efficient, even when it was a bit busy. It is a lovely place to satisfy a pastry craving, and I would definitely come back to try more.
